title: xo Space record (<XO root>/.xo/space.json)
description: What this Space is: its captured id, its label, its roots and the agent backends attached to it. Written by the single-writer sink services/cowork_agent/visualizer/workspace/space_json.py. Schema 1 at this path was the derived d3 graph, which moved to ~/.quirq/workspace/graph.json and is still served at GET /xo/space.json (syncplan T14) — the route's URL is a name, not a path. The project list is deliberately NOT here: it lives in projects.json, so the two records keep different writers and different write frequencies.

schema.description: 1 was the derived graph that used to occupy this path.

space_id.description: CODER_WORKSPACE_ID — captured from the environment, never minted. Null off Coder (syncplan O1); a locally generated fallback must never be committed, because it would diverge from the externally assigned id the moment the same Space runs on Coder.

label.description: Human name for the Space. Seeded once from CODER_WORKSPACE_NAME and user-editable thereafter — the writing sink does not own this key and carries it forward untouched.

owner_user_id.description: The auth state's user_id, or "local". A resolved id is never downgraded back to "local" by a momentarily unreadable auth state.

projects_root.description: Absolute path to the xo-projects root.

state_root.description: Absolute path to the machine-local Quirq state root (~/.quirq).

agents.description: One row per discovered agent manifest, sorted by name. Discovered, never enumerated in core code.

active.description: Whether this is the backend AGENT_NAME resolves to.

binary_available.description: Whether the manifest's binary is on PATH.

capabilities.description: The capability modules present under adapters/<name>/.

first_seen_at.description: Set once, the first time this agent appears in the record.

last_used_at.description: When this agent was last observed active. Refreshed on a coarse interval (XO_SPACE_AGENT_TOUCH_S, default 1 h) — a per-tick stamp would rewrite this file every second.
